summary: Constrains, normalizes, loops, zigzags, or quantizes pixel values and can also quantize pixel positions to create stepped image effects.

key_params.name: minop
key_params.note: off, clamp, loop, or zigzag for low values

key_params.name: maxop
key_params.note: off, clamp, loop, or zigzag for high values

key_params.name: positive
key_params.note: Apply absolute-value behavior after other value operations

key_params.name: norm
key_params.note: Normalize final output after other limiting work

key_params.name: quantvalue
key_params.note: off, ceiling, floor, or round value quantization

key_params.name: quantpos
key_params.note: off, ceiling, floor, or round position quantization

common_gotchas: Loop and zigzag are wrapping modes, not clamp variants, so out-of-range values can re-enter the interval.
Normalize is applied after other limiting and quantization work and can be more expensive.
Position quantization changes spatial sampling rather than channel values.
The official docs spell spatial as spacial in the position-quantization section, but the ids are posstep and posoffset.
key_concepts: Limits image pixel values by clamping, looping, or zigzagging below and above thresholds.
Minimum and maximum functions are independent, so low and high bounds can behave differently.
Value quantization snaps channel values to floor, ceiling, or round steps.
Position quantization groups pixels in UV space, similar to lowering resolution and scaling back without filtering.
Normalize runs after limiting and quantization and uses extra internal passes.
The operator supports 3D Textures and 2D Texture Arrays.
